source.note: Exact immutable StageA code/SDK checkpoint. Companion evidence records per-run fingerprints; unregistered StageB API/path-codec drafts are excluded. Search remains native and coupled.

contract.version_status: No installed search contract negotiated; planned file_search version1 is not implemented.

ownership.state: Session owns roots/options, native index/query state, reporter and private shutdown. Async owner owns bounded accepted-session leases, readiness/close receipts and retained failures; caller-supplied cancellation remains separate from private close.
ownership.dependencies: ignore traversal; pinned modified Nucleo; dedicated Rayon pool; crossbeam worker signaling; Tokio blocking execution and TaskTracker for async admission/join ownership.
ownership.lifecycle: Retain supervisor, walker and pool OS handles. Close first fences notifications, stops/joins producers, quiesces matcher then joins pool workers. Async create reserves before startup; abandoned waiters release leases while accepted startup/cleanup remains supervised. Successful close/shutdown observes joins; failures remain reportable.
ownership.cancellation: Private request_close does not mutate a shared external cancellation flag. Query idle, external cancellation, joined close and process termination are distinct. Tagged positive increasing query identities precede callbacks.

intentional_customizations: Replace detached native worker ownership with explicit joinable lifecycle and async retained owner.
Carry query identity through snapshots/completion so consumers can reject stale A-to-B-to-A results.
Propagate worker/reporter/pool failures and typed observed-startup cleanup outcomes. Constructor errors retain conservative cleanup outcomes.
preserved_native_behavior: Existing match/options/result types and file/directory classification; traversal ignores, exclusions, followed symlinks, deepest root, scoring and highlighting.
Standalone run_main flags/output/no-pattern listing remain native; run now closes its session before reporting completion.
remaining_gaps: No independently installed file_search component contract, selected backend factory, process adapter or native/custom search package is active in Stage A.

Fourth native consumer remains codex-rs/rollout/src/list.rs::find_thread_path_by_id_str_in_subdir -> file_search::run; externalizing App Server/TUI/standalone alone will not replace storage lookup fallback.
Process-wide App Server search quota, bounded/coalesced native query ingress, index entry/byte budgets and opt-in logical IPC limits remain Stage B requirements.
Public App Server search DTOs remain unchanged. Added native Rust query identity is not an installed wire-contract version.
OS filesystem operations and process-aborting native failures do not gain a hard cancellation deadline or guaranteed recovery.

ownership.state: Native matcher state stays in Nucleo; file-search owns its supplied dedicated pool and retains actual OS worker handles.
ownership.dependencies: Vendored Nucleo0.5.0 and unchanged matcher0.3.1 source from the recorded pin, Rayon1.13.0 in the enclosing dependency graph.
ownership.lifecycle: new_with_thread_pool permits caller panic handling and thread ownership; consuming shutdown disables matcher notifications, cancels and waits for worker-lock quiescence. intentional_customizations: Source patch adds dedicated-pool construction and explicit consuming matcher quiescence.
Worker matcher allocation uses the supplied pool actual thread count.
Vendor manifest omits absent upstream bench workspace member; matcher LICENSE symlink is materialized for portable packages.
preserved_native_behavior: Matching/scoring/sorting algorithms, dependency versions and matcher defaults remain unchanged.
Ordinary Nucleo constructor default thread selection/names/failure behavior and ordinary Drop remain unchanged.

license.note: Covered source and local modifications retain MPL-2.0; surrounding Codex Apache-2.0 does not relicense these files.

remaining_gaps: Nucleo shutdown is quiescence, not proof of OS-thread exit without file-search joins.
No Rayon source patch, global pool adoption or hard shutdown deadline.
Targeted vendor provenance is not a complete transitive-license audit.

ownership.state: Connection state owns session IDs, one-shot cancellation tokens, admission generations and startup/publisher trackers. Native owner retains accepted search work. Processor retains connection cleanup failures after connection removal.
ownership.dependencies: Native managed search owner; existing public JSON-RPC DTOs; connection RPC gate and serialization queue; targeted bounded outgoing queue; network/in-process shutdown composition.
ownership.lifecycle: Fence connection search admission before draining admitted RPCs; join startup, native sessions and publishers before graceful completion. Session stop cancels blocked outgoing reservations and joins before reply. Forced network exit issues synchronous search fence but does not claim joins.
ownership.ordering: One latest-state publisher per session; expected tagged ID precedes native update; reservation commits under query/close fence; updates precede completion. Stop is a queue-admission fence, not client-render acknowledgement.
ownership.cancellation: Same-token predecessor cancellation occurs before replacement capacity admission. Empty query/root cancellation needs no native slot; old lease remains charged until its cleanup ends. Tokens and session IDs are scoped to connection.

intentional_customizations: Broadcast search notifications become targeted to their owning connection.
Session IDs no longer serialize unrelated connections.
One-shot/native/publisher cleanup failures reach callers and final shutdown instead of successful empty responses.
Startup rejection is distinct from native cleanup failure; publisher always joins after failed construction.
preserved_native_behavior: Public search RPC names/DTOs,50-result/up-to12-worker policy, highlighting, score/path sort and existing path presentation.
Existing same-token cancellation intent and empty-query empty result.
remaining_gaps: Per-connection capacity16 does not impose a process-wide quota; selected provider/global scopes remain Stage B.
No file_search package selection or independent install acceptance yet.
Current forced path is cancellation/uncertainty, not graceful join proof.
Already admitted frames can precede stop response; transport delivery/rendering is not acknowledged by queue fencing.
